response: Laparoscopic cholecystectomy does influence peri-sinusoidal cell activity. The procedure causes detectable damage to Kupffer and endothelial cells, as reflected by the elevation of post-operative hyaluronic acid (HA) serum levels. However, the damage to the liver hepatocytes and perisinusoidal cells has no clinical significance. The laparoscopic procedure itself is the probable cause of the Kupffer and endothelial cells damage, while other mechanisms are responsible for the damage to the hepatocytes.
